video.caption: Recorded from the Streamlit demo running locally: a 5 MB message is split into 80 segments, shuffled, reassembled and verified, then sent between a real sender and receiver over TCP. Both runs end in PASS.

shots.alt: The Gossipsub 1.4 demo before a run: payload, chunk size, expected segments and a Run Quick Demo button
Live Network run in progress: the sender log lists shuffled segments with checksums, and the receiver log acknowledges each one
Finished run: segmenting, shuffling, reassembly and verification steps, an 80-chunk segment map, and Interoperability status: PASS with 80 of 80 checksums

note: Media captured from the demo running locally; the project is not deployed.
